community: OC Moms / New Parents Orange County
text: Vợ chồng em sắp có bé đầu lòng, ở Irvine. Cả nhà setup gì đầu tiên vậy ạ? (bảo hiểm, làm will, ghế xe, phòng cho bé...) Lần đầu làm ba mẹ nên hơi rối 😅
comment_source_reason: New parents in Orange County publicly asking what to set up first draws people sharing a genuine new-dependent trigger, CA professionals of every trade congratulating with a self-pitch, and insurance agents pitching life/health policy reviews — a natural source of both consumer leads and competitor pitches for an insurance-agent client.
